from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = GalaxyInstance("https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)
history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b56417cac1b3ee29c7"

# R script for DESeq2
r_script = r'''
set -eu

# Read the count matrix
counts <- as.matrix(read.table("$(inputs.counts.path)", header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE))

# Ensure integer counts
counts <- round(counts)

# Define conditions: first 3 columns = DMSO, next 3 = CBD_IC50
condition <- factor(c(rep("DMSO", 3), rep("CBD_IC50", 3)))
col_data <- data.frame(row.names=colnames(counts), condition=condition)

# Build DESeq2 dataset
suppressMessages(library(DESeq2))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, colData=col_data, design=~condition)

# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results: CBD_IC50 vs DMSO (CBD is numerator, DMSO is denominator)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"))
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res$GeneID <- rownames(res)
res <- res[, c("GeneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]

# Write results
write.table(res, file="deseq_results.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, na="NA")
'''

# Encode the script with base64 (no newlines)
script_b64 = base64.b64encode(r_script.encode()).decode()

# Build shell command that decodes and runs
shell_command = f'''SCRIPT_B64='{script_b64}'
python3 -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("run_deseq2.sh").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
chmod +x run_deseq2.sh
bash run_deseq2.sh'''

representation = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "deseq2-cbd-crc-v1",
    "name": "DESeq2 CBD vs DMSO CRC",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/bioconductor-deseq2:1.50.2--r45ha27e39d_0",
    "shell_command": shell_command,
    "inputs": [
        {
            "name": "counts",
            "type": "data",
            "format": ["tabular"]
        }
    ],
    "outputs": [
        {
            "name": "deseq_results",
            "type": "data",
            "format": "tabular",
            "from_work_dir": "deseq_results.tsv"
        }
    ],
    "requirements": [
        {
            "type": "resource",
            "cores_min": 4,
            "ram_min": 8
        }
    ]
}

print("Creating UDT...")
created = gi.unprivileged_tools.create_user_tool(representation)
print(f"UDT created: {json.dumps(created, indent=2)[:500]}")

uuid = created["uuid"]
print(f"\nUUID: {uuid}")

# Submit the UDT
tool_inputs = {
    "counts": {
        "src": "hda",
        "id": "f9cad7b01a472135acacb370edfea6cb"
    }
}

print("\nSubmitting UDT...")
submitted = gi.tools.run_tool(
    history_id=history_id,
    tool_uuid=uuid,
    tool_inputs=tool_inputs,
)

for job in submitted.get("jobs", []):
    print(f"Job ID: {job['id']}, State: {job['state']}")

# Save job ID
with open('/workspace/deseq2_udt_job.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump({'uuid': uuid, 'job_id': submitted['jobs'][0]['id']}, f)
